mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 15 degrees now, moderate rain. Next 24 hours: high 16, low 10.

Serbian politician Rada Trajković from Kosovo asked Serbia's Security and Intelligence Agency (BIA) to officially disclose the whereabouts of Milan Radoičić, who is alleged to be linked to the Banjskë region and the murder of Oliver Ivanović.

Kosovo has been placed 14th worldwide for safety and public order in Gallup's 2025 Law and Order Index, ranking ahead of Denmark and Finland among the top 15 countries.

A new daily tablet, chemically similar to Viagra, slowed the progression of Alzheimer's disease by 31% in a study of more than 1,500 patients, though the benefit was observed only in a specific subgroup.

The European People's Party, the largest political family in Europe, has proposed suspending Serbia's Serbian Progressive Party, led by President Aleksandar Vučić.

Rockstar Games announced that Grand Theft Auto VI will launch on November 19, ending a twelve-year wait and sparking massive excitement among millions of fans worldwide.
